title: poikilospermum borneense
intro: Poikilospermum borneense, commonly known as the Borneo wood fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Polygonaceae. It is traditionally used in Southeast Asian medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Poikilospermum borneense include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which help to reduce pain, fever, and infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and lignans, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
